integration_changes: Copied planner.py, decide.py, and llm_planner.py from the archive; source-file hashes above identify the originals.
Added an adapter in controller.py for task identity, normalized history, B profile, main-owned IDs/seeds/timeouts, and C parameter validation.
Offline rule decisions pass a null remaining budget; vendored decide.py was adapted to permit null only for explicit offline_rules mode.
Vendored llm_planner.py includes B training profile and C capabilities in its JSON context; the event sink discards event details so prompt/reply bodies are not logged.

School mode injects the shared gateway, validates complete supplier usage, propagates gateway exceptions directly from LLMPlanner.next_plan(), and records only whether the LLM or rule fallback supplied the decision.
The gateway owns supplier usage and reserved/unknown ledger records; LLMPlanner is constructed without its legacy BudgetTracker.
Did not import upstream run.py, task_adapter.py, evaluate.py, budget.py, or package entry points.
